title: Checkpointed recommendation deployer with idempotent commit and webhook fencing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a checkpointed recommendation deployer API and SDK helpers that allow Optimize to safely apply batching/caching recommendations with idempotent commits, checkpointed rollbacks, and robust webhook fencing. This ticket covers the server-side endpoints, webhook contract, idempotency key lifecycle, SDK convenience methods, observability hooks, and a fallback DLQ plan for failed applies. The goal is to enable autonomous optimize pipelines (recommendation generation -> staged apply -> verification -> commit/rollback) with minimal human intervention while guaranteeing at-most-once effects and clear auditability.
acceptance_criteria: A1: POST /optimize/v1/deploys accepts a deploy request with required idempotency-key; duplicate requests with same key are deduplicated and return the original operation id
A2: Each deploy creates a checkpointed preview ID that can be inspected and used to rollback without side effects

A3: Webhook contract: optimize.deploy.status sends structured events (preview_created, apply_started, apply_succeeded, apply_failed, rollback_completed) with checkpoint_id and canonical idempotency metadata
A4: SDK exposes applyWithCheckpoint(deployRequest, options) that manages idempotency keys, retries, and webhook subscription helpers
A5: Operation-level observability: trace id, token-level cost delta estimate, and per-route latency shown in Console rollouts dashboard
A6: Finalized commits are atomic from the caller perspective (no double-apply), with audit logs stored for 90 days
A7: Failed apply >3 retries moves to DLQ with annotated error and automatic rollback trigger if partial state detected
tasks: Persistence: checkpoint model for preview diffs and a compact undo log
Webhook: design and implement event signing + replay protection
SDK: add applyWithCheckpoint and idempotency helpers (Node + Python)
Observability: emit trace IDs and token delta to Console and metrics pipeline
E2E tests: simulate retries, duplicate idempotency keys, and partial failures
Runbook: add DLQ handling and manual rollback steps to oncall runbook

2026-02-20 | Sofia Martinez (Design): UX notes - Console should show preview diff and allow manual approve/auto-approve rule. Also want inline cost delta estimate per suggestion. Filed DES-482 for UI mockups.

2026-02-24 | Liam Chen: Implemented prototype endpoint and checkpoint persistence. Linked PR #1942 (prs). Running integration test that simulates 10k recommendations - will surface scaling concerns for preview storage. Found that naive storage writes cause spikes; will add compact diff encoding.

2026-02-27 | Security (Rajiv Kumar): Reviewed webhook signing approach. Recommended HMAC with rotating key + key id header. Also requested a short TTL for replay window and mandatory event_id. Marked security_review_required=true

2026-03-01 | Aisha Patel: Design decision logged: choose at-most-once semantics using idempotency-key + operation state machine (PENDING -> PREVIEW_READY -> APPLYING -> COMPLETED/FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK). Added DLQ path for persistent failures. Next: SDK work and e2e harness.
2026-03-01 | Liam Chen: Blocker - need a small infra quota bump for ephemeral preview storage to run perf tests. Filed INFRA-79 for quota increase.
notes: Trade-offs considered: synchronous preview generation would simplify UI but blocks caller and increases latency; chosen async checkpoint approach trades more storage for responsive API and clearer rollback. Rollout plan: internal flag for 2 weeks, then gradual enable by org. Manual rollback tooling to be available for first 30 days.
